flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ff6600 then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Open the color picker from the swatch next to the search field.
Press Tab through at least three controls unless the swatch gets focus sooner.
If it gets focus, @v16:"press Enter".
Verify the color spectrum and hue slider appear.

summary:
The color picker’s visible swatch is not included in keyboard navigation, so keyboard-only users cannot open it to see the color spectrum and hue slider.
Make the swatch a keyboard-focusable control and support Enter or Space to open it. Confirm that the opened picker exposes both the color spectrum and hue slider to keyboard users.
evidence: objective_contradiction: After three Tabs, the visible swatch is skipped in both Tab directions and cannot be opened with permitted keys.
one_liner: The visible color swatch beside the search field cannot be reached or opened using the permitted keyboard controls.

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the required keyboard-only approach: it pressed Tab three times as required and then tried Shift+Tab to check the reverse focus order.
